task.timing_contract: Contemporaneous reported location-quality diagnostics, never pre-event earthquake forecast or independent true depth error.
task.calibration: Complete spatiotemporal connected clusters held out; same snapshot networks/measurement procedures. No new waveform or independent hypocenter calibration.
task.independent_unit: Transitive clusters within100km great-circle chord and7days; complete cluster hashfolds. Distant events may still share network/systematic velocity model errors.
task.scope_limits: One July2026 catalog snapshot. Positive uncertainty reports only; mixed network estimation conventions, no universal standard-error confidence interpretation. Counts/geometry are outputs of location processing and causality is not identified.

exposure.schema: Native schema inspected and source-public aggregate descriptions known; case10 status counts were inspected, not new endpoint NVD-score presence scores. No reserved individual target metric printed.

task.uncertainty_policy: Whole-group errors/ranges; no row bootstrap or manufactured independent-population confidence. Confirmation becomes exposed after freeze.

selection: Minimize group-balanced primary error; prefer fewer coefficients within1percent of minimum; baseline may win.
stopping: At least5distinct scientific hypotheses, adaptive to development evidence; stop after2consecutive substantive attempts without accuracy/robustness/interpretation gain.
